_comment: Runner configuration. Plan names and variants are data, not code: whichever way Q1 is answered (OID4VP 1.0 Final vs the ID2 draft), switching target is an edit here rather than a change to the runner. Per-developer values -- above all the ngrok hostname baked into Verify's own docker-compose.yml -- belong in a gitignored configs/runner.local.json, which is deep-merged over this file with components matched by name.

components.description: Inji Verify 1.0.0-alpha.1 - OID4VP 1.0 Final alpha verifier - automated run

browser.comment: Copied from the suite's own CI config (scripts/test-configs-rp-against-op/vp-verifier-test-config.json): captures the suite-served evidence page to fill the verification-result screenshot placeholder without human interaction. Replaces our earlier guessed pattern, which never matched.

credential._comment: The key the suite signs its test credential with. Private: lives in the gitignored configs/keys/ and is read in at run time. Generate with the suite's own scripts/generate-vp-test-cert.py (docs/handbook Part 2).

components._comment_endpoint: The runner calls Verify's API directly on localhost. The public ngrok host is still mandatory, but for a different reason: it is baked into the response_uri and did:web values Verify issues, which the conformance suite must reach from inside its own container.

verifierRequest._comment: Target: the Inji 1.0 line, run from docker/docker-compose.yml (profile verify), whose Inji Verify config lives in docker/inji-verify/. apiVersion '1.0' means DCQL, /v2/vp-session-request, and a reproduction of the 1.0 SDK. The credential's clientIdPrefix is locally set to pre_registered so the request is delivered inline, matching the url_query variant.
verifierRequest._comment_credential: The suite's verifier tests always present a credential with vct urn:eudi:pid:1 (hard-coded in CreateSdJwtKbCredential.java:17) in the 1.0 Final format dc+sd-jwt. A verifier must ask for that, or it will -- correctly -- reject the presentation. This entry is added locally to Inji Verify's config.json; the shipped 'Mock Identity (SD JWT)' asks for a different vct in the superseded vc+sd-jwt format.

components.version: 1.0.x (MOSIP QA build of release-1.0.x, digest sha256:2c72a78c)
components.description: Inji Certify release-1.0.x - OID4VCI 1.0 Final alpha issuer - pre-authorized code, SD-JWT

planConfig._comment: vci.credential_issuer_url contains the per-developer public host, so it is set in the gitignored configs/runner.local.json: "https://<PUBLIC_HOST>". The client keys are private: generate them with scripts/generate-client-jwks.py.

vci._comment: static_tx_code must equal issuerRequest.txCode: the harness asks Certify for offers that require this code, and the suite sends it. A test value, not a secret.

issuerRequest._comment: The offer the harness asks Certify for before each delivery. Claims cover every claim of the SD-JWT credential configuration in docker/inji-certify/sd-jwt-credential-config.json.
